content.comment_body: My [product_name] module currently monitors and controls my solar hot water boiler. I can collect live data, such as temperature and operating hours, via the online test in the [product_name] software. I'd like to display this data on my computer with Visual Basic, and eventually integrate the module into my home automation system. Does anyone know how to connect to the [product_name] and retrieve data for use in Visual Basic? Also, what communication protocol does [company_name] use between [product_name] and the associated software? For reference, I have uploaded sample graphics intended for the computer display.
Hello! There's a way to save all [product_name] variables to Excel. The last thread I saw on this topic is at [url]. You might be able to use this Excel data in Visual Basic.
That looks promising, I will check it out, and also look on the German site.

Here's a direct link to the Excel Logger attachment from my previous answer: [document]. This logger records I/O status and all digital flags every second or at longer intervals. I'm developing a second version that will also log block values and include more options. Best regards, [user_name]

You can download a demo version of the driver at [url]. Demo version limitations: - Only supports [article_no]. - Saving files is not permitted. If you’re interested in purchasing the full product, please reply and I’ll share the purchase link.
I'm looking forward to the new version when it is ready. One suggestion: could you also provide an English translation? Google Translate is okay, but not perfect.
Does the [product_name] logger work with a USB cable?

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are trying to extract and display data from a [product_name] controller using Visual Basic, Excel, or third-party drivers. The current [company_name] ecosystem does not offer simple, direct options for exporting or integrating data into external applications, leading users to seek alternative software and workarounds. There is a clear need for more seamless and user-friendly ways to connect [product_name] devices to other platforms for data integration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks an uncomplicated way to gather both real-time and historical data from their [product_name] module, with compatibility for Visual Basic and home automation. Ideally, solutions would leverage a documented and supported [company_name] protocol or API.
